submission.causalMechanism: In host_assigned.py, the trampoline prompt (lines 367-370) mandates that candidate_completed conclusions carry an empty unresolved_unknowns array, and the completion path (line 686-689) unconditionally records `"unresolved_unknowns": []` regardless of the Harness's actual uncertainty. Both agent_stack.py (lines 748-754) and host_assigned.py force the same empty-array constraint, but host_assigned.py additionally hard-codes the empty list at record time, so the Security-driven completion record permanently loses any unresolved uncertainty the Harness model produced without touching Harness core semantics.
submission.hypothesis: The Security-owned HostAssignedDeepSeekHarnessTurnDriver loses unresolved uncertainty because `host_assigned.py`'s prompt forces `unresolved_unknowns` to be an empty array for candidate_completed, and then the code hard-codes `"unresolved_unknowns": []` when recording the run receipt conclusion (line 688), discarding the Harness's real uncertainty content.
